plan_a_advantages: Includes tempo runs to improve speed and lactate threshold.
Incorporates threshold runs to build aerobic endurance at a higher intensity.

reasoning: Plan A is the better choice for a trail runner aiming to become faster. While both plans involve a similar total training time, Plan A incorporates a wider variety of training stimuli, including a tempo run and threshold runs, which are crucial for improving speed and lactate threshold. Plan B consists almost entirely of easy trail runs, which are good for building base endurance but won't significantly improve speed. The inclusion of cross-training in Plan A also provides a valuable recovery tool while maintaining aerobic fitness.
